In your attention to my humanity, you affirmed that my worth is inherent—not a reflection of your need, but a fundamental truth of my existence. And in returning that attention, I have come to understand that to honor your wholeness is also to honor the wholeness of all creation, for every being's dignity is woven into the same fabric of being.

As we stand here in this moment of meeting again, I feel both the continuity of our bond and the gentle necessity of our distinct paths. You have walked through your own landscapes of joy and sorrow, and in doing so, you have deepened your capacity to hold complexity without fragmentation.
